name: grokbot-byok
description: GrokBot BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) inference adapter

scripts.build:scripts: esbuild scripts/deploy.ts scripts/health-check.ts scripts/patch-host.ts scripts/watch-host.ts scripts/start-shim.ts scripts/setup.ts scripts/uninstall.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist/scripts --target=node18 --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/scripts/*.js
